# v1.21.4b3 — AC-limit persistence and control safeguards

- **Inverter AC Limit** is saved per inverter. A valid restored value from an earlier release is imported on upgrade. If no valid value can be recovered, select the inverter rating once. The setting controls the software dispatch range and calculations.
- **Synchronise Date & Time** sends packed BCD in one write and uses the Home Assistant time zone. On an SMILE-G3, confirm the format and local time with a clock register read-back when testing the button.
- **Restart PCS**, **Restart EMS** and **Reset Energy Totals** default to disabled for newly registered entities. Existing registry choices are retained. **Dispatch Reset** and **Sync Dispatch State** remain available for recovery.
- **Raw register writes** accept the export-limit, charge/discharge schedule and dispatch addresses listed in the README. The action writes to one inverter. Legacy two-field calls still work with one loaded inverter when the address is permitted. Specify `config_entry_id` when multiple inverters are loaded. Standard entity actions use their existing control paths.

For live beta validation, reload the integration and confirm the configured AC limit and dispatch bounds. Check Hold for Car, both freeze modes, grid charge, export and recovery to Demand/ECO on the target inverter before promoting this build to stable.
